paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是三对伴侣，因为对方带进家里的某样东西而感到不满。每个人都试图划出一条界线，但问题最后都比一开始看上去复杂得多。

在邓菲家，克莱尔在家庭电脑上发现了一张色情图片，并认定是卢克看了它。菲尔知道这张图片其实是同事发给自己的，却没有纠正她。相反，他说自己会亲自和卢克谈谈。

菲尔走进卢克房间，开始问一些关于怎样从电脑里删除东西的问题。卢克却以为菲尔说的是海莉的私人日记，因为他偷偷看过那本日记。由于父子俩谈的根本不是同一件事，菲尔离开时还以为自己已经解决了问题。

后来，卢克向克莱尔承认，自己确实看了不该看的东西。克莱尔试着平静地和他谈，接着才意识到，卢克说的是海莉的日记，不是那张图片。这引发了孩子们之间的一场大吵。等所有人都说那张色情图片不是自己的，菲尔终于不得不承认真相。

克莱尔其实并不是真的因为图片而生气。她难过的是，卢克在她眼里依然是那个小男孩，而她希望他能尽可能久地保持单纯。菲尔因为让卢克替自己背锅而向他道歉，随后又给了他远远超出需要的信息，立刻把谈话弄得无比尴尬。

与此同时，杰买了一座巨大的狗形管家雕像。他叫它巴克利，还觉得它特别好笑。格洛丽亚却非常讨厌它，因为每次走进房间都会被吓一跳。她试着把雕像藏起来，却不小心扯掉了它的一只手。

杰生气了，而两个人的争吵很快就不再只是关于那座雕像。格洛丽亚说，杰喜欢的很多东西自己也一直忍着；杰则抱怨床上那些没完没了的装饰抱枕。谁都不肯让步。

米切尔和卡梅隆本来要带莉莉去看一场木偶戏，那是米切尔小时候很喜欢的节目。出发前，卡梅隆看到他们家的园丁在外面哭，于是把他请进屋里。卡梅隆几乎不会说西班牙语，所以根本不知道园丁遇到了什么问题，却还是不停试着帮助他。

米切尔越来越生气，因为卡梅隆总会在别人需要帮助时，立刻放弃他们原本的计划。两个人吵了起来，米切尔独自离开。可是和杰谈过之后，米切尔意识到，卡梅隆的善良同样也是自己爱他的原因之一。

他回家准备道歉，却发现卡梅隆已经帮园丁在他们的客厅里举办了婚礼。这一天没有任何人的计划顺利进行，但最后，他们都接受了一个事实：那些最让自己抓狂的习惯，也同样是所爱之人身上的一部分。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about three couples getting annoyed by something their partner brings into the house. Each of them tries to set a limit, but the problem turns out to be more complicated than it first seems.

At the Dunphy house, Claire finds a dirty picture on the family computer and assumes Luke was looking at it. Phil knows the picture was actually sent to him by a coworker, but he doesn’t correct her. Instead, he says he’ll talk to Luke himself.

Phil goes into Luke’s room and starts asking questions about deleting things from a computer. Luke thinks Phil is talking about Haley’s private journal, which he secretly read. Because they’re discussing two completely different things, Phil leaves the room believing he has solved the problem.

Later, Luke admits to Claire that he looked at something he shouldn’t have. Claire tries to have a calm talk with him, but then realizes he means Haley’s journal, not the picture. This starts a huge argument between the children. When everyone says the dirty picture wasn’t theirs, Phil finally has to admit the truth.

Claire isn’t really angry about the picture. She was upset because Luke is still her little boy, and she wants him to stay innocent for as long as possible. Phil apologizes to Luke for letting him take the blame, then immediately makes the conversation awkward by giving him far more information than he asked for.

Meanwhile, Jay has bought a large statue of a dog dressed as a butler. He calls it Barkley and thinks it’s hilarious. Gloria hates it because it scares her every time she walks into the room. She tries to hide it and accidentally tears off one of its hands.

Jay gets angry, and the argument soon becomes about more than the statue. Gloria says she puts up with things Jay likes, while Jay complains about all the decorative pillows on their bed. Neither of them wants to give in.

Mitchell and Cameron are supposed to take Lily to a puppet show that Mitchell loved as a child. Before they leave, Cameron sees their gardener crying outside and invites him in. Cameron barely speaks Spanish, so he has no idea what the man’s problem is, but he keeps trying to help.

Mitchell becomes frustrated because Cameron often drops their plans whenever someone else needs him. They argue, and Mitchell leaves without him. After talking to Jay, however, Mitchell realizes that Cameron’s kindness is also one of the things he loves about him.

He returns home to apologize and discovers that Cameron has helped the gardener hold his wedding in their living room. The day doesn’t go as planned for anyone, but they all end up accepting that the habits that drive them crazy are also part of the people they love.
